host_delta: Fold packet aggregation into the existing transient FIELD machine handoff: every packet reduces to exactly one of NOW / DELTA / RESIDUE / GATE / NEXT / ARCHIVE without becoming a queue, store, route, or authority source.
law: Packet egress is derived, never packet-authorized. Canonical precedence is GATE → NOW → RESIDUE → NEXT → DELTA → ARCHIVE. Only caller-supplied CURRENT/explicit selection context can create NOW; packet current/state/precomputed-egress labels cannot. DELTA requires material change plus host-attested sufficient EVIDENCE; unwitnessed material change is RESIDUE. STOP suppresses continuation; historical/superseded material remains ARCHIVE unless explicitly reactivated.

residue: The reducer classifies egress only; it does not choose project priority or execute NEXT.

Evidence sufficiency is asserted by the owning adapter/host; the generic reducer does not infer domain proof.
